scope.claim: Confirm whether the unchanged fixed-K8, shortlist-four, beam-width-three cascade lowers group-normalized tree-selection regret relative to fixed-K8 Q-only selection under the frozen wide-range synthetic distribution.
not_claimed: a rigorous error bound or safety certificate

adaptive_lineage.source_primary_outcome: The v1 energy-mass cascade did not satisfy its preregistered positive-evidence rule.
adaptive_lineage.selection_disclosure: fixed-K8/beam3 was a preregistered v1 baseline, but it is promoted here after observing v1 outcomes; this new stage is therefore required for a primary confirmation claim.
adaptive_lineage.unchanged_candidate: The K=8 root band, four-tree Q shortlist, B=3 joint cell-beam, calibration seeds, innovation label, model fitting, and stable tie rules are unchanged from the v1 baseline.
adaptive_lineage.v1_heldout_reuse: No v1 held-out input, graph, oracle label, fitted parameter, threshold, or confidence gate is used by v2 scoring. V1 aggregate outcomes are used only to select the candidate and plan sample size.

sample_size_planning.allocation: 64 independent input groups at each of three widths, 192 groups total
sample_size_planning.rationale: The balanced 192-group design was fixed before v2 opening. Under a normal approximation and exact repetition of the disclosed v1 exploratory effect and variance, it gives about 90% probability that a two-sided 95% interval excludes zero in the positive direction.
sample_size_planning.stopping_rule: No early stopping, sequential extension, or sample-size increase is permitted after opening. All 192 complete groups are required for the primary analysis.

experimental_unit: one ordered stored-FP32 input group; its 64 graph rows are paired

stored_input.dtype: positive normal IEEE-754 binary32 represented exactly
stored_input.materialization: wide_range_random samples exponent uniformly from [-32,4], a uniform 23-bit fraction field, then shuffles with Python random.Random(seed)
stored_input.ordering: the generated shuffled order is consumed unchanged
stored_input.validity: all 64 graph observations must complete; otherwise preserve the partial directory and do not silently rerun or include a partial group

heldout_seeds.policy: first 31 bits of SHA256('wide_range_fixed_k8_beam_v2|input|<width>|<index>'), indices 0..63; explicitly materialized below before opening

graphs.freshness: The offset gives v2 a graph-seed namespace disjoint from v1 evaluation graphs.

target.raw_preserved: exact signed root forward error as a rational and in root-ULP units
target.ties: all equal minimum targets form the oracle best tier
target.degenerate_group: if all targets tie, hit is one and normalized regret is zero; ranking correlation is undefined

predictor.macro_score: Q_8/12, the connected eight-node root-band ULP energy divided by 12; lower is better
predictor.micro_score: B=3 joint cell-beam expected squared signed root error in root-ULP units; lower is better
predictor.allowed_inputs: stored leaves, candidate graph, deterministic shadow features, and the innovation model fitted only on the declared calibration groups
predictor.candidate_selection: score all 64 trees by Q_8/12, retain the four lowest, then choose the lowest beam score

baseline.selection: choose the lowest Q_8/12 over all 64 trees

metrics.primary: mean paired normalized-regret improvement: regret(fixed-K8 Q-only) - regret(fixed-K8/B3 beam cascade)
metrics.positive_evidence_rule: the 95% stratified input-group bootstrap interval lower bound for the primary metric is greater than zero
secondary: global oracle-best-tier hit rates and their paired difference
beam benefit, harm, and exact-tie rates relative to Q-only
metrics.normalization: within each group, (selected target - group minimum)/(group maximum - group minimum); zero when all targets tie
metrics.undefined_reporting: undefined pairwise accuracy or rho is retained as null and its defined-group count is reported
metrics.weighting: each input group has equal weight; pooled bootstrap preserves equal width allocation
metrics.multiplicity: only the paired regret improvement is confirmatory; all secondary metrics are descriptive

cost_boundary.frozen_structural_work: 64 Q_8 scores and at most four K=8, B=3 beam scores per input group
cost_boundary.runtime_claim: No production runtime claim is made by this validation because the research runner retains exact Fraction-based instrumentation and oracle evaluation.
cost_boundary.next_if_confirmed: Implement and benchmark a score-only inference path that removes oracle and Fraction instrumentation before making a cheapness claim.

opening.required_worktree: clean Git worktree containing this frozen preregistration
opening.overwrite: forbidden; an existing or partial directory blocks execution
opening.after_opening: score, target, sampling unit, graph set, primary metric, sample size, and uncertainty procedure are immutable; changes require another validation stage
